text: Lena said she never knows when to send an invoice. After the call? After the project? She waits two weeks because she is afraid it looks pushy. Her last client paid 41 days late and she did not chase.
Honest question: how soon after finishing work should I invoice? I always feel awkward doing it the same day.
Hi, quick one. Is the price per client or per user? I read the page twice and I still cannot tell. I work alone but I have three clients.

Ines runs a small design studio. She said chasing late payments is the part of the job she hates most. She pays herself last and sometimes not at all when clients are slow. She wants a polite reminder that does not sound angry.
Moved the Thursday sync to 3pm. Dentist at 2. Remember to bring the laptop charger.
I send reminders but clients ignore them. Do you have wording that actually works without being rude?
We have everything in a spreadsheet, about 300 rows, and I am scared to move it. What happens to my old invoice numbers if I switch?

Marcus said the first invoice went out the day the work was done and the client paid in 6 days instead of 30. Before that he waited a week to feel polite and it took 38 days on average. Sending it the same day changed everything for him.
Does the price change if I add a second user for my bookkeeper? I only need her to look, not edit.
My biggest fear is the awkward email when a client is 30 days late. I rewrite it five times and never send it.
Cat knocked the plant off the shelf again. Need a heavier pot. Also order printer paper.

Dev moved from spreadsheets last month. He said the scary part was the old invoice numbers, he thought they would all reset. They did not. The import took 12 minutes and he wished someone had told him it was that quick.
When do I send the invoice if the client wants to approve the work first? I never know whether to send before or after the approval.
Love this. Also, the pricing page says per workspace, is that the same as per user?
Tessa said she once ran a whole month on a client who paid 62 days late. She did not chase because she did not want to lose the account. She said a script for the first reminder would have saved her.
Funny story from the airport: the gate agent asked if my laptop was a toaster. I said yes. She waved me through. Not sure it is useful for anything.
I have been invoicing from Word for six years. Is it worth switching? What do I actually gain? I do about 20 invoices a month.
Great post. I also procrastinate on sending invoices because I want to review the work one more time. Is that normal?
Priya asked how the per user pricing works when her assistant only needs to view reports. She would pay for one seat if viewers were free.
Can you remind me what the late fee wording should be? My client is 21 days late and I want to be firm but friendly.
Invoice reminder emails sent in the first week of November got a 58 percent open rate. The firm but friendly template was used in 14 of them. Worth writing up.
Anyone else paste their old spreadsheet into the new tool and hold their breath?
Leo asked about a calendar sync and whether the app has dark mode. Nothing about invoicing. He was friendly and the call ran 9 minutes.
Thanks! Perfect, got it working. Will send feedback next week.
